items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I went with Charlie Barnet first... I came back, and we played the Oriental... I wrote those songs for Charlie Barnet.

ctx.x: Now, this would really bring us back to the time you worked with Hot Lips Page, then.
Yeah, I... Well, let me see... Hot Lips... that's right... I went with Charlie Barnet first, before...
